name: v32_gross_income_range_coverage
hypothesis: A narrow gross-income estimate range with rising gross-income estimate coverage may capture margin visibility distinct from sales dispersion.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(gross_income_max - min_gross_income_quarterly_estimate) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(num_gross_income_est, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_30_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Non-sales analyst uncertainty using gross-income range/count; strict corr gate against akdb1ZqR.
